RBLBANK: Governance Shifts And ENBD Agreement Will Shape Steady Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target on RBL Bank broadly steady at about ₹347 per share, citing largely unchanged views on fair value, discount rate, growth and profit margin assumptions, along with a slightly adjusted future P/E multiple. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for April 25, 2026 to consider and approve the audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider a proposal for recommending a dividend on equity shares for that financial year.

news.title: RBLBANK: Governance Changes And ENBD Agreement Will Shape Balanced Future Outlook
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for RBL Bank higher, taking the price target from ₹338.39 to ₹346.89, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margin, discount rate and future P/E. What's in the News The Extraordinary General Meeting on May 4, 2026 approved amendments to the Articles of Association and granted a special right for director nomination to an identified shareholder of the bank (Key Developments).

news.title: RBLBANK: Upcoming Governance Changes Will Support Future Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have adjusted their price target on RBL Bank from ₹410 to ₹390, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples in their valuation work. What's in the News Board meeting on April 11, 2026 to consider an amendment agreement to the existing investment agreement with Emirates NBD Bank (P.J.S.C) and to consider convening an extra ordinary general meeting (company filing) Extraordinary general meeting scheduled for May 4, 2026 to seek shareholder approval for amendments to the Articles of Association and to grant a special right on director nomination to an identified shareholder (company filing) Special or extraordinary shareholders meeting on May 4, 2026 at 11:00 Indian Standard Time, aligning with the proposed changes to governance documents

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹14.34 (vs ₹11.81 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.34 (up from ₹11.81 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹82.3b (up 13% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹8.79b (up 23% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 11% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 22% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.7% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 18% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 26% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: RBL Bank Limited Proposes Dividend
news.body: Board of Directors of RBL Bank Limited at its meeting held on April 25, 2026 proposed a dividend of INR 1/- per share (face value of INR 10/- each) (previous year: INR 1/- per share), subject To Approve the members at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. Effect of the proposed dividend has been reckoned in determining capital funds in the computation of capital adequacy ratios as at March 31, 2026.

news.title: RBLBANK: Governance Amendments And ENBD Agreement Revisions Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on RBL Bank slightly, with fair value moving from about ₹343 to around ₹338, reflecting updated assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for April 11, 2026, at 10:04 Indian Standard Time to consider an amendment agreement to the existing investment agreement with Emirates NBD Bank (P.J.S.C) and to consider convening an extraordinary general meeting of the bank (Key Developments).

news.title: RBLBANK: Board And Leadership Moves Will Support Future Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have kept the price target for RBL Bank steady at ₹410, pointing to updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that balance each other out in their valuation work. What's in the News RBL Bank has scheduled a Board Meeting on Jan 17, 2026, to consider and approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, subject to a limited review by the Joint Statutory Auditors (Key Developments).

news.title: RBLBANK: Governance Changes And Lower Risk Assumptions Will Support Upside
news.body: Analysts have maintained the fair value for RBL Bank at ₹342.56 per share, while adjusting key assumptions such as a lower discount rate, more moderate revenue growth and profit margin expectations, and a higher future P/E multiple to reflect updated views on the bank’s risk and earnings profile. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for January 17, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, subject to a limited review by joint statutory auditors (Board Meeting).

news.title: RBLBANK: Leadership Changes And Board Uncertainty Will Restrict Medium-Term Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for RBL Bank broadly unchanged at around ₹250.50. The updated assumptions reflect a slightly lower discount rate, small tweaks to revenue growth expectations, a higher profit margin forecast and a reduced future P/E, which together influence the latest price target narrative.

news.title: Rbl Bank Limited Announces Directorate Changes
news.body: RBL Bank Limited announced that Mr. Rajeev Ahuja, Executive Director of the Bank, has retired from the services of the Bank upon completion of his term and has accordingly ceased to be the Whole-time Director (designated as Executive Director) and Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank with effect from the close of business hours of February 20, 2026. Mr. Jaideep Iyer has assumed charge as a Whole-time Director (designated as Executive Director) and a Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank effective February 21, 2026. His term as approved by the Reserve Bank of India and Shareholders is for a period of three years i.e. with effect from February 21, 2026, till February 20, 2029. news.title: RBLBANK: Leadership Reshuffle And Governance Moves Will Support Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on RBL Bank from ₹305 to ₹410. The change is mainly tied to updated assumptions for higher revenue growth of about 40%, a profit margin estimate of roughly 26%, a slightly lower discount rate of around 14.18%, and a reduced future P/E of about 6.87x.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.71 (vs ₹0.78 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.71 (up from ₹0.78 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹20.7b (up 41% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.28b (up 382% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 11% (up from 3.2% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 23% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.5% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 14% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 24% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: RBLBANK: Emirates Stake Proposal And Governance Changes Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for RBL Bank from ₹333.22 to ₹335.72 per share, reflecting updated assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E expectations. What's in the News Emirates NBD Bank PJSC has proposed acquiring a 26% stake in RBL Bank for approximately ₹120b at ₹280 per share, with the offer expected to close on December 26, 2025 (M&A Transaction Announcements).
